description_en: Queries all workspace roles of a user

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Quick BI user. This is not your Alibaba Cloud account ID. You can call the QueryUserInfoByAccount (https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/quickbi-public/2022-01-01/QueryUserInfoByAccount?spm=api-workbench.api_explorer.0.0.672f50daGq9ooV\&params=%7B%7D\&tab=DOC\&sdkStyle=old\&RegionId=cn-hangzhou) operation to obtain the user ID

30: Workspace Viewer (preset role)
